sources.title: Gemma passes 1 billion downloads - The Keyword
sources.snippet: When we introduced Gemma, our goal was simple: empower developers to build responsible, innovative AI applications anywhere. The Gemma models quickly demonstrated their flexibility to deploy across environments, from local devices to edge infrastructure, and even space. Today, the Gemma family has surpassed a billion downloads.
